label: Splunk Enterprise
description: Splunk Enterprise 10.6.2.5, installed but never started: each clone creates its own administrator, GUID and data on first boot.
usage: Installed but uninitialized Splunk Enterprise. After the first boot of a clone, run sudo initialize-splunk-lab --accept-license and create its administrator. Splunk Web 8000, management (TLS) 8089, receiver 9997. No credentials, GUID or index data in the image. Lab sizing, not production.
